iso_group.process_step:
#########
# GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
# and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
####

#########
# Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
####

# create directory structure and move into it
mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_hylo/download -p /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_parks/etl
chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_2021_hylo
cd /data/mdc_2021_hylo

# set update flag based on last update and update frequency
do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1

# download if update flag is set:
if do_update == 1 then
wget --retry-connrefused --waitretry=1 --read-timeout=20 --timeout=15 -t 10 -O download/mdc_2021_hylo.zip 'https://scholarship.miami.edu/view/fileRedirect?instCode=01UOML_INST&filePid=13395678880002976&download=true' 2>&1

# unzip to download directory if update flag is set
if do_update == 1 then
unzip -o download/mdc_2021_hylo.zip -d download && rm download/mdc_2021_hylo.zip 2>&1

# load raster into postGIS with:
    raster2pgsql -s 3857 -d -C -I -t 48x48 GeoTIFF_Rasters/Parks_Euclid_Dist_30m_MDC.tif -F mdc_distance_to_parks > load_raster.sql
psql <connection options> < load_raster.sql
rm load_raster.sql

# create color raster
mkdir -p /tiles/raster/mdc_distance_to_parks
mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_parks/derived
cd /data/mdc_2021_hylo
cat > /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_parks/derived/mdc_distance_to_parks_color_ramp.txt <<_EOF
0 159 212 140 255
150 158 211 139 230
330 157 210 138 199
525 156 209 136 166
720 155 208 135 133
915 154 207 134 99
1110 152 206 133 66
1305 151 205 131 33
1500 150 204 130 0
_EOF
gdaldem color-relief download/GeoTIFF_Rasters/Parks_Euclid_Dist_30m_MDC.tif /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_parks/derived/mdc_distance_to_parks_color_ramp.txt /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_parks/derived/mdc_distance_to_parks_color.tif -alpha
# create color raster and render raster tiles 
mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_parks/derived
mkdir -p /tiles/raster/mdc_distance_to_parks
cd /data/mdc_2021_hylo
echo "" | base64 -d > /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_parks/derived/mdc_distance_to_parks_legend.png
cp /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_parks/derived/mdc_distance_to_parks_legend.png /tiles/raster/mdc_distance_to_parks/
# render raster tiles 
cd /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_parks/
gdal2tiles.py -ex --xyz -z 8-16 /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_distance_to_parks/derived/mdc_distance_to_parks_color.tif /tiles/raster/mdc_distance_to_parks
